question: As of November 2022, who among the following is the Governor of Kerala, India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arif Mohammed Khan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of November 2022, **Arif Mohammed Khan**__ is the** Governor of Kerala, India.**
 
• He is a former Member of Parliament and a former Cabinet Minister in the Government of India.
 
• He has held several portfolios ranging from energy to civil aviation
 
• He was appointed as the **22nd Governor of Kerala** in September 2019 and is **currently serving**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mangubhai Chaganbhai Patel**__ is the current Governor of Madhya Pradesh, appointed in September 2021.

 __
 
• He has earlier served as a cabinet minister in the Government of Gujarat.
 
 
 
• **Ganesh Lal Mathur **is a retired Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer who served as the **Chief Secretary of Rajasthan** and **retired **in 2010.
 
• **Bhagat Singh Koshyari** was the** 22nd Governor of Maharashtra** from 5 September 2019 to 17 February 2023
 
 
• He also served as the **2nd Chief Minister of Uttarakhand**.
 
 
 
• **Ramesh Bais** is the** current governor of Maharashtra** since February 18, 2023.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**The Governors of states:

 
• Governors have been discussed under Article 153 to Article 162 of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Governor is the constitutional head of a state in India and is responsible for the administration of the state.
 
• Under Article 155, the appointment of the Governor is done by the President of India by warrant under his hand and seal.
 
• He/She holds office at the pleasure of the President, which means that the President can remove the Governor from office at any time without assigning any reason.
 
• The term of governor's office is normally 5 years but it can be terminated earlier.
 
• He/She can also resign from his/her office by addressing the resignation letter to the President.
 
• Under Article 157, the qualifications for appointment as a Governor are: A Governor must
 
 
• be an Indian citizen and reside in the country.
 
• attain an age of a minimum of 35 years.
 
• not be a member of both houses of the parliament and the house of the state legislature.
 
• not hold any office for generating profit.
